target_zone_range.evidence_basis: Hays and Travis are explicitly documented in the UT Central Texas Berberis field work; Williamson has a dedicated county treatment.

morphology.look_here_first: Start with the leaves: agarita is usually trifoliolate, with 3 stiff holly-like leaflets, blue- to yellow-green foliage, and a dense rounded shrub habit. Yellow spring flowers are followed by red berries.

confusers.separator: B. swaseyi usually has 5–9 leaflets, more open habit, duller gray-green strongly reticulate foliage, and reduced basal leaflet pairs. Hybrids occur, so leaflet count alone is not sufficient.
